1: class Battle
2:   #=============================================================================
3:   # Choosing Pokémon to switch
4:   #=============================================================================
5:   # Checks whether the replacement Pokémon (at party index idxParty) can enter
6:   # battle.
7:   # NOTE: Messages are only shown while in the party screen when choosing a
8:   #       command for the next round.
9:   def pbCanSwitchIn?(idxBattler, idxParty, partyScene = nil)
10:     return true if idxParty < 0
11:     party = pbParty(idxBattler)
12:     return false if idxParty >= party.length
13:     return false if !party[idxParty]
14:     if party[idxParty].egg?
15:       partyScene&.pbDisplay(_INTL("An Egg can't battle!"))
16:       return false
17:     end
18:     if !pbIsOwner?(idxBattler, idxParty)
19:       if partyScene
20:         owner = pbGetOwnerFromPartyIndex(idxBattler, idxParty)
21:         partyScene.pbDisplay(_INTL("You can't switch {1}'s Pokémon with one of yours!", owner.name))
22:       end
23:       return false
24:     end
25:     if party[idxParty].fainted?
26:       partyScene&.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} has no energy left to battle!", party[idxParty].name))
27:       return false
28:     end
29:     if pbFindBattler(idxParty, idxBattler)
30:       partyScene&.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is already in battle!", party[idxParty].name))
31:       return false
32:     end
33:     return true
34:   end

36:   # Check whether the currently active Pokémon (at battler index idxBattler) can
37:   # switch out.
38:   def pbCanSwitchOut?(idxBattler, partyScene = nil)
39:     battler = @battlers[idxBattler]
40:     return true if battler.fainted?
41:     # Ability/item effects that allow switching no matter what
42:     if battler.abilityActive? && Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerCertainSwitching(battler.ability, battler, self)
43:       return true
44:     end
45:     if battler.itemActive? && Battle::ItemEffects.triggerCertainSwitching(battler.item, battler, self)
46:       return true
47:     end
48:     # Other certain switching effects
49:     return true if Settings::MORE_TYPE_EFFECTS && battler.pbHasType?(:GHOST)
50:     # Other certain trapping effects
51:     if battler.trappedInBattle?
52:       partyScene&.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} can't be switched out!", battler.pbThis))
53:       return false
54:     end
55:     # Trapping abilities/items
56:     allOtherSideBattlers(idxBattler).each do |b|
57:       next if !b.abilityActive?
58:       if Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerTrappingByTarget(b.ability, battler, b, self)
59:         partyScene&.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} prevents switching!", b.pbThis, b.abilityName))
60:         return false
61:       end
62:     end
63:     allOtherSideBattlers(idxBattler).each do |b|
64:       next if !b.itemActive?
65:       if Battle::ItemEffects.triggerTrappingByTarget(b.item, battler, b, self)
66:         partyScene&.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} prevents switching!", b.pbThis, b.itemName))
67:         return false
68:       end
69:     end
70:     return true
71:   end

73:   # Check whether the currently active Pokémon (at battler index idxBattler) can
74:   # switch out (and that its replacement at party index idxParty can switch in).
75:   # NOTE: Messages are only shown while in the party screen when choosing a
76:   #       command for the next round.
77:   def pbCanSwitch?(idxBattler, idxParty = -1, partyScene = nil)
78:     # Check whether party Pokémon can switch in
79:     return false if !pbCanSwitchIn?(idxBattler, idxParty, partyScene)
80:     # Make sure another battler isn't already choosing to switch to the party
81:     # Pokémon
82:     allSameSideBattlers(idxBattler).each do |b|
83:       next if choices[b.index][0] != :SwitchOut || choices[b.index][1] != idxParty
84:       partyScene&.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} has already been selected.",
85:                                   pbParty(idxBattler)[idxParty].name))
86:       return false
87:     end
88:     # Check whether battler can switch out
89:     return pbCanSwitchOut?(idxBattler, partyScene)
90:   end

92:   def pbCanChooseNonActive?(idxBattler)
93:     pbParty(idxBattler).each_with_index do |_pkmn, i|
94:       return true if pbCanSwitchIn?(idxBattler, i)
95:     end
96:     return false
97:   end

99:   def pbRegisterSwitch(idxBattler, idxParty)
100:     return false if !pbCanSwitch?(idxBattler, idxParty)
101:     @choices[idxBattler][0] = :SwitchOut
102:     @choices[idxBattler][1] = idxParty   # Party index of Pokémon to switch in
103:     @choices[idxBattler][2] = nil
104:     return true
105:   end

107:   #=============================================================================
108:   # Open the party screen and potentially pick a replacement Pokémon (or AI
109:   # chooses replacement)
110:   #=============================================================================
111:   # Open party screen and potentially choose a Pokémon to switch with. Used in
112:   # all instances where the party screen is opened.
113:   def pbPartyScreen(idxBattler, checkLaxOnly = false, canCancel = false, shouldRegister = false)
114:     ret = -1
115:     @scene.pbPartyScreen(idxBattler, canCancel) do |idxParty, partyScene|
116:       if checkLaxOnly
117:         next false if !pbCanSwitchIn?(idxBattler, idxParty, partyScene)
118:       elsif !pbCanSwitch?(idxBattler, idxParty, partyScene)
119:         next false
120:       end
121:       if shouldRegister && (idxParty < 0 || !pbRegisterSwitch(idxBattler, idxParty))
122:         next false
123:       end
124:       ret = idxParty
125:       next true
126:     end
127:     return ret
128:   end

130:   # For choosing a replacement Pokémon when prompted in the middle of other
131:   # things happening (U-turn, Baton Pass, in def pbEORSwitch).
132:   def pbSwitchInBetween(idxBattler, checkLaxOnly = false, canCancel = false)
133:     return pbPartyScreen(idxBattler, checkLaxOnly, canCancel) if !@controlPlayer && pbOwnedByPlayer?(idxBattler)
134:     return @battleAI.pbDefaultChooseNewEnemy(idxBattler)
135:   end

137:   #=============================================================================
138:   # Switching Pokémon
139:   #=============================================================================
140:   # General switching method that checks if any Pokémon need to be sent out and,
141:   # if so, does. Called at the end of each round.
142:   def pbEORSwitch(favorDraws = false)
143:     return if @decision > 0 && !favorDraws
144:     return if @decision == 5 && favorDraws
145:     pbJudge
146:     return if @decision > 0
147:     # Check through each fainted battler to see if that spot can be filled.
148:     switched = []
149:     loop do
150:       switched.clear
151:       @battlers.each do |b|
152:         next if !b || !b.fainted?
153:         idxBattler = b.index
154:         next if !pbCanChooseNonActive?(idxBattler)
155:         if !pbOwnedByPlayer?(idxBattler)   # Opponent/ally is switching in
156:           next if b.wild?   # Wild Pokémon can't switch
157:           idxPartyNew = pbSwitchInBetween(idxBattler)
158:           opponent = pbGetOwnerFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler)
159:           # NOTE: The player is only offered the chance to switch their own
160:           #       Pokémon when an opponent replaces a fainted Pokémon in single
161:           #       battles. In double battles, etc. there is no such offer.
162:           if @internalBattle && @switchStyle && trainerBattle? && pbSideSize(0) == 1 &&
163:              opposes?(idxBattler) && !@battlers[0].fainted? && !switched.include?(0) &&
164:              pbCanChooseNonActive?(0) && @battlers[0].effects[PBEffects::Outrage] == 0
165:             idxPartyForName = idxPartyNew
166:             enemyParty = pbParty(idxBattler)
167:             if enemyParty[idxPartyNew].ability == :ILLUSION && !pbCheckGlobalAbility(:NEUTRALIZINGGAS)
168:               new_index = pbLastInTeam(idxBattler)
169:               idxPartyForName = new_index if new_index >= 0 && new_index != idxPartyNew
170:             end
171:             if pbDisplayConfirm(_INTL("{1} is about to send out {2}. Will you switch your Pokémon?",
172:                                       opponent.full_name, enemyParty[idxPartyForName].name))
173:               idxPlayerPartyNew = pbSwitchInBetween(0, false, true)
174:               if idxPlayerPartyNew >= 0
175:                 pbMessageOnRecall(@battlers[0])
176:                 pbRecallAndReplace(0, idxPlayerPartyNew)
177:                 switched.push(0)
178:               end
179:             end
180:           end
181:           pbRecallAndReplace(idxBattler, idxPartyNew)
182:           switched.push(idxBattler)
183:         elsif trainerBattle?   # Player switches in in a trainer battle
184:           idxPlayerPartyNew = pbGetReplacementPokemonIndex(idxBattler)   # Owner chooses
185:           pbRecallAndReplace(idxBattler, idxPlayerPartyNew)
186:           switched.push(idxBattler)
187:         else   # Player's Pokémon has fainted in a wild battle
188:           switch = false
189:           if pbDisplayConfirm(_INTL("Use next Pokémon?"))
190:             switch = true
191:           else
192:             switch = (pbRun(idxBattler, true) <= 0)
193:           end
194:           if switch
195:             idxPlayerPartyNew = pbGetReplacementPokemonIndex(idxBattler)   # Owner chooses
196:             pbRecallAndReplace(idxBattler, idxPlayerPartyNew)
197:             switched.push(idxBattler)
198:           end
199:         end
200:       end
201:       break if switched.length == 0
202:       pbOnBattlerEnteringBattle(switched)
203:     end
204:   end

206:   def pbGetReplacementPokemonIndex(idxBattler, random = false)
207:     if random
208:       choices = []   # Find all Pokémon that can switch in
209:       eachInTeamFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler) do |_pkmn, i|
210:         choices.push(i) if pbCanSwitchIn?(idxBattler, i)
211:       end
212:       return -1 if choices.length == 0
213:       return choices[pbRandom(choices.length)]
214:     else
215:       return pbSwitchInBetween(idxBattler, true)
216:     end
217:   end

219:   # Actually performs the recalling and sending out in all situations.
220:   def pbRecallAndReplace(idxBattler, idxParty, randomReplacement = false, batonPass = false)
221:     @scene.pbRecall(idxBattler) if !@battlers[idxBattler].fainted?
222:     @battlers[idxBattler].pbAbilitiesOnSwitchOut   # Inc. primordial weather check
223:     @scene.pbShowPartyLineup(idxBattler & 1) if pbSideSize(idxBattler) == 1
224:     pbMessagesOnReplace(idxBattler, idxParty) if !randomReplacement
225:     pbReplace(idxBattler, idxParty, batonPass)
226:   end

228:   def pbMessageOnRecall(battler)
229:     if battler.pbOwnedByPlayer?
230:       if battler.hp <= battler.totalhp / 4
231:         pbDisplayBrief(_INTL("Good job, {1}! Come back!", battler.name))
232:       elsif battler.hp <= battler.totalhp / 2
233:         pbDisplayBrief(_INTL("OK, {1}! Come back!", battler.name))
234:       elsif battler.turnCount >= 5
235:         pbDisplayBrief(_INTL("{1}, that's enough! Come back!", battler.name))
236:       elsif battler.turnCount >= 2
237:         pbDisplayBrief(_INTL("{1}, come back!", battler.name))
238:       else
239:         pbDisplayBrief(_INTL("{1}, switch out! Come back!", battler.name))
240:       end
